Ward Round – 07/03/2020, 00:33 (overnight consultant review, intensive care unit)

Background: Admitted to hospital at 00:11 on 06/03/2020 with confirmed COVID-19
pneumonia and hypoxaemia. Required rapid escalation and was admitted to the intensive care
unit at 09:09 on 06/03/2020 for ongoing respiratory support.

Observations: Temperature 37.6°C, HR 96 bpm, RR 24/min, SpO2 95% on CPAP with FiO2 0.5,
BP 118/70 mmHg. NEWS2 not routinely scored on organ support.

Bloods: CRP falling from peak, lymphopenia persisting, renal function stable, ABG showing
mild residual hypoxaemia with normal pH and lactate.

VTE prophylaxis: Enoxaparin first dose given 10:00 on 06/03/2020, continued once daily, no
bleeding concerns identified.

Escalation status: Full escalation of care is in place, for continued organ support as required;
discussed with family regarding progress.

Plan: Continue CPAP with aim to wean FiO2 as tolerated. Continue enoxaparin od. Daily
bloods and ABG. Proning to be considered if oxygenation deteriorates. Physiotherapy and
nursing care to continue. Review again on morning ward round with ICU team.
